scope: Public Singapore travel-benefit documents relevant to JourneyBack; all rules require current-policy and product verification before customer-facing use.
known_limitations: Official PDF URLs and searchable text were verified, but the site viewer did not export original PDF binaries into the workspace.
Policy wordings published in 2021 remain publicly accessible; current production use requires issuer/insurer confirmation of the latest version.
The corpus is Singapore-first and does not yet cover every Amex card or APAC market.
No chunk may be used to promise coverage or automatically approve a claim.
